scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @studio/shared && concurrently -k -n storefront,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:storefront" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @studio/shared && npm run build --workspace @studio/image-renderer && npm run build --workspace @studio/storefront && npm run build --workspace @studio/admin && npm run build --workspace @studio/api && npm run build --workspace @studio/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @studio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/storefront && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/image-renderer
scripts.test: npm run test:pricing && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:payments
